page_note: 本页为报告第20页「3.3 Energy」小节，含一个无编号的KPI彩色表格（KPI 17–19）、两段正文，以及Figure 8的五序列电价折线图和其Source行、脚注区。

heading.title: Electricity prices for companies in the EU and other advanced economies.

figures.source_line: Source: Eurostat, US Energy Information Administration (EIA), the UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ) and the International Energy Agency (IEA)113.

components.evidence: legend row "EU IC band  EU ID band  UK  USA  Japan" sits inside the plot, level with the 0.4 tick
"EUR/kWh" printed top-left inside the plot, level with the top tick 0.4, not beside the axis
y ticks are bare numbers 0.05 ... 0.4; only "EUR/kWh" fixes their scale
year labels 2015 ... 2024 are set at roughly 45 degrees under the axis
faint horizontal rules at each 0.05 tick across the panel, no vertical rules drawn
"Source: Eurostat, US Energy Information Administration (EIA), the UK Department..." under the plot
superscript 113 after "the International Energy Agency (IEA)" in the source line
table cell "Electricity as a share of the total energy consumption.107" carries superscript 107

new_components.name: table_row_fill_encodes_status
new_components.evidence: KPI 17 and KPI 18 rows filled yellow, KPI 19 row filled green, in the same bordered table
new_components.why_it_matters: 行底色本身携带「是否有目标/是否达标」的额外信息，若解析成纯文本表格则该维度丢失，读者无法区分KPI 19与其他行的状态差异。

new_components.name: unnumbered_kpi_table
new_components.evidence: bordered table with header row "KPI | What it measures | Target | Latest EU value", no figure number or caption
new_components.why_it_matters: 表中直接印有 "EUR 0.16 per kWh (2024)"、"EUR 0.20 per kWh (2023)" 等与Figure 8同源的数值，但无编号标题，取值时需靠列头而非图号来定位。

new_components.name: value_year_inside_cell
new_components.evidence: cells read "21.3% (2022)" and "20.8% (2021)" — two year-tagged values stacked in one cell
new_components.why_it_matters: 一个单元格内含两个带年份的取值，定位某一年数值需要同时用KPI名与括号内年份，普通行列键不足以唯一寻址。

difficulty_notes: 卡在读数。图上0到0.4共约348像素，每0.05刻度约43像素，5%容差对0.06只有0.003即约2.6像素、对0.16也只有0.008即约7像素，而线宽本身约3–4像素，所以USA、Japan这类低位序列基本无法读到容差内。更糟的是2015–2021段EU IC band、EU ID band与UK三条线挤在0.10–0.15之间且相互交叉，序列归属先于数值就已模糊；全图50个点无任何印刷数字，只有EU ID band的0.16与0.20在上方KPI表中以文字形式出现。

suggestions.what_to_add: axis_title_above_axis 与独立的 unit 字段（"EUR/kWh" 悬浮于图内左上、与顶刻度齐平）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图表样式条件行中的标题/单位位置字段，以及记录的 heading 结构（number/title/subtitle/unit/placement 分开存放）
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 新增一行「单位不在标题也不在轴标签、而是图内浮动文字」，对比解析器能否把 EUR/kWh 绑定到裸小数刻度上

suggestions.what_to_add: P1 式的按标记可达精度（小量级序列如 USA 0.06、Japan 0.13 的容差只有2–6像素）
suggestions.where_to_change: readable 判定字段，由布尔门改为随刻度间距与线宽计算的每点精度
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 新增一行「值轴量程0–0.4、刻度步长0.05时，低位密集序列的可达精度」，区分能否读与读到几位

suggestions.what_to_add: tick_format 维度：小数刻度 0, 0.05, 0.1 … 0.4 与旋转45°的年份刻度组合
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段中的刻度格式与x轴刻度旋转角
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 新增一行「小数值轴 + 旋转年份刻度」，检验解析输出中年份键与数值精度是否同时保住
